text:
rita (Docs): Drafting the release notes for this sprint. Heads-up: includes whatsnew blurb, migration notes for SDK streaming, and a couple known issues (link TTL & anchor redirects). Need quick review.
leo (Product): Can we be explicit in the whatsnew banner that the adaptive routing fallback reduces cost but may increase variance in tail latency? Keep it short.
rita (Docs): Proposed banner line: "Adaptive routing may fall back to compatible model variants under heavy load — lowers cost but may change tail latency." OK?
ida (SDK): good. Also update the Python and JS streaming snippets — API shape changed to client.responses.stream. I'll paste both minimal examples.
ida (SDK): JS snippet:
```js
const stream = client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-7b', input: 'Summarize the changes' });
for await (const part of stream) console.log(part.text);
```
ida (SDK): Py snippet:
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
for chunk in client.responses.stream(model='rwd-3b', input='Summarize'): 
    print(chunk.text)
```
rita (Docs): added both and a version note: "Requires SDKs >= 1.4.0 (JS) / >= 0.9.0 (Python). Old .stream_raw()/.streamResponses() are deprecated."
nate (Eng): One more known issue to call out: preview links created by the publisher have a 1-hour TTL; public links use 14-day TTL after CDN fix. Workaround: publish stable page or request extended TTL. (ENG-2267)
rita (Docs): added line with ticket ENG-2267. Also added a short migration bullet for reranker name change: rwd-ranker-v2 (ENG-2255).
leo (Product): Support asked for a short troubleshooting checklist for customers who hit deprecation warnings. Can you add 3 quick steps?
rita (Docs): Added under Migration: 1) Check SDK version; 2) pip/npm update to latest; 3) clear local cache and restart. Kept it terse.
kb-bot: PR 4922 opened by rita: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4922|view PR> :spiral_note_pad:
ida (SDK): Small nit: banner JS example was still using legacy name client.streamResponses(); fixed in the PR to client.responses.stream().
rita (Docs): thanks, updated. Aiming to merge after 1-hour review. Ping if you want changes. :thumbsup:
